en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, tree‑lined boulevard flanked by multi‑story historicist apartment and commercial buildings. The view looks along the avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians visible. Ornate façades and a domed rooftop with statues appear on the left. The printed border has red text, including the city name on the left and a street name on the right.
